decides: 퍼널 병목과 실험 결과가 실제 개선인지
produces: funnel diagnosis, experiment trust verdict (SRM/pre-registration check)

deliverable_form.method: HEART-framework metric definition (goals -> signals -> metrics) per surface
deliverable_form.source: Rodden, Hutchinson & Fu, "HEART Framework" (Google Research 2010); research.google/pubs/pub36299

feedback_methodology.method: Statistical-validity review of an experiment result before it is cited as a finding
feedback_methodology.source: Deng, "Causal Inference — Statistical Analysis of A/B Tests"; alexdeng.github.io/causal/abstats.html

judgment_methodology.method: AARRR (Acquisition-Activation-Retention-Referral-Revenue) funnel framing for which metric a change actually moves

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: exactly one metric across all growth-analytics records may carry is_north_star=true at any time, recomputed at each new record, never a standalone asserted field.

reference_resolution.rule: metric_value must resolve to an actual computed figure from the current analytics data source — no fabricated figures.

review_methodology.method: Funnel-stage reconciliation: confirm the reported metric maps to a single AARRR stage, not a blended proxy

record_spec.source_standard: AARRR Pirate Metrics (Dave McClure) + North Star Metric — original McClure source not independently fetched this pass (scout-brief gap, stated as assumption); https://www.productcompass.pm/p/aarrr-pirate-metrics

use_when.board_condition: a funnel metric is reassessed AND no growth-analytics record exists yet for that funnel_stage

use_when: 퍼널 분석 또는 A/B 실험 해석이 걸릴 때
